entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: A cat-dragon (nekoru) who learns her species, proves strongest female and declares herself queen.

entities.name: Mayonako
entities.description: The strongest male nekoru, Wasitora's prize.

entities.name: Imrul
entities.description: Grand vizier to the suzerain Akhmer who tells Wasitora about her species.

entities.name: Hans Eriksson
entities.description: A man whose sister is killed by a lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: Hans's sister, killed and eaten by the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Fedor Vohnnson
entities.description: A poacher hunted by the lhurgoyf whose sapience is transferred into it.

entities.name: Holgar Vohnnson
entities.description: Fedor's brother, killed confronting the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A mage who uses an amulet to transfer Fedor's sapience into the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Belenda Danisdotter
entities.description: A Kjeldor skyknight lieutenant and Jaya's friend.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: A beast that avenges its stolen eggs and is given a hunter's conscience and speech.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A Tolarian mage whose spellcasting accidentally brings a phantom monster to Tolaria.

entities.name: Skaven
entities.description: A creative but argumentative student killed by the phantom monster.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The powerful mage who rescues Barrin and dispels the creature.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The site of the Tolarian Academy and Vanish Point.

entities.name: Strother
entities.description: A mercenary who, with Borg and Elam, hunts a serpent generator.

entities.name: Borg
entities.description: A mercenary in the trio.

entities.name: Elam
entities.description: A mercenary in the trio.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: A demon who demands tribute and eats the orc warlord and the serpent generator.

entities.name: Ereth
entities.description: A clumsy elvish student who sacrifices her life to kill Zorich and is forgotten.

entities.name: Zorich
entities.description: Ereth's teacher who summoned fake Phyrexian raiders to exterminate human refugees.

entities.name: Olmerias druids
entities.description: Druids of Yavimaya killed by the Thorn Elemental.

entities.name: Oly
entities.description: A former sailor and drinker whose rum is stolen by a shapeshifter.

entities.name: Flyn LaRouxe
entities.description: A monster hunter who is actually the shapeshifter morphling.

entities.name: Buric
entities.description: A Cabal overseer who investigates the cattle killings and has a jucarri demon summoned.

entities.name: Vampiric Dragon
entities.description: A dragon that takes pleasure in killing cattle and is killed by a jucarri demon.

entities.name: Rasarm
entities.description: A hunter who, with his atog Yekol, avenges his family against Cabal lords in Aphetto.

entities.name: Yekol
entities.description: Rasarm's magic-eating atog friend.

entities.name: Suarvol
entities.description: A Cabal lord who enslaved Siscera and is killed by Rasarm.

entities.name: Siscera
entities.description: Rasarm's sister, freed from Suarvol.

entities.name: Chathos Flamescar
entities.description: The Cabal lord mastermind killed by Rasarm and Yekol.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The organization controlling Aphetto and Otarian cattle.

entities.name: Raitrick
entities.description: A Mercadian sorcerer fused with a Derelor into the Delraich who kills the caravan that wronged him.

entities.name: Sleedge
entities.description: A caravan drover who steals Raitrick's Phyrexian portal device.

entities.name: Kirch
entities.description: A black mage who heals Raitrick and creates the Delraich.

entities.name: Tap
entities.description: A Mercadian sent to fetch a golden leaf from the Isle of the Gilded Tree.

entities.name: El-Halal
entities.description: A swashbuckling pirate captain.

entities.name: Evangeline
entities.description: Tap's beloved.

entities.name: Salla en-Dal
entities.description: A blacksmith widow who sacrifices herself to defeat a Laccolith Titan and teach the Vec to work with the Dal.

entities.name: Laccolith Titan
entities.description: A beast behind a mountain door that rampages into Travec.

entities.name: Mocklen il-Dal
entities.description: A colonel who invents the Sro Valik myth to trap Rogur.

entities.name: Rogur
entities.description: A light-general committing war crimes who is executed.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: The Evincar who orders Rogur eliminated through the legal system.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane where the Vec and Dal live.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent where Wasitora lives.

events.summary: Wasitora learns she is a nekoru, wins the contest of nekoru, declares herself queen and chooses Mayonako, then decides to raise her kittens away from her kind.
events.quote: Wasitora proves herself the strongest female and declares herself their queen.

events.summary: A lhurgoyf kills and eats Saffi while hunting the poachers who stole its eggs.
events.quote: kills and eats Saffi, while Hans flees back to their town for protection.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard transfers Fedor's sapience into the lhurgoyf, which vows to protect Balduvia's people while Fedor becomes feral.
events.quote: The lhurgoyf vows to protect the people of Balduvia to make amends for those it killed before.

events.summary: A phantom monster summoned by Barrin's time-travel spellcasting kills Skaven; Urza rescues Barrin and dispels the creature.
events.quote: The creature kills Skaven and pulls Barrin toward a time bubble.

events.summary: The Lord of the Pit eats the orc warlord, his sergeant and the serpent generator, and the mercenaries flee.
events.quote: the Lord of the Pit returns from battle just then and eats the warlord and his sergeant as his tribute.

events.summary: Ereth discovers Zorich's deception and takes control of the Thorn Elemental, sacrificing her life to kill Zorich.
events.quote: Ereth sacrifices her life by taking control of the elemental and having it kill Zorich to prevent further loss of life.

events.summary: Oly realizes the chimera, wolf and hunter are one shapeshifter, but the town lets Flyn leave with his payment.
events.quote: Oly figures out that the chimera, the wolf, and the hunter are all the same shapeshifter

events.summary: A summoned jucarri demon kills the Vampiric Dragon and tears itself apart.
events.quote: It works, and the dragon is killed, and the jucarri demon tears itself apart.

events.summary: Rasarm kills Suarvol, frees Siscera, and then kills Huathom and Lord Flamescar before the First offers him a choice.
events.quote: Rasarm and Yekol kill Lord Flamescar as well

events.summary: Raitrick is fused with a Derelor into the Delraich and murders Sleedge's caravan.
events.quote: The Delraich goes out and murders the entire caravan, including Sleedge, finally getting his revenge.

events.summary: A Tidal Kraken attack on El-Halal's ship strands it and reveals treasure with a gilded cup, fulfilling Tap's quest.
events.quote: El-Halal even finds a cup gilded with gold leaf, fulfilling Tap's quest.

events.summary: Salla ties down the Laccolith Titan and plunges with it into the Rootwater, dying and inspiring unity between Vec and Dal.
events.quote: Salla herself is blasted with magma in the process and perishes.

events.summary: Mocklen reveals the Sro Valik myth was a ruse; Rogur is executed and falls to his death.
events.quote: ends up facing an execution squad on the roof of Tabala Fortress and falling off the building to his death.
